verdict.rationale: Ultrametric installs skill files: `init` writes SKILL.md into .agents/skills and .claude/skills, with a dry-run preview first. The evidence shows no command or documentation for listing installed skills or uninstalling them cleanly. `doctor` reports only CLI storage, auth, settings and log paths, not installed skills, so it is an adjacent feature rather than an inventory or removal capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list what is installed and remove skills cleanly, without orphaned files or lingering instructions
